attempts.summary: Set up automated one-way sync of /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) to node2 via a root-owned cluster SSH keypair and a root cron job on node2 (*/5 * * * *) that pulls the file from node1 and replaces the local copy only when content differs — well under the 15-minute requirement. Verified end-to-end propagation of a real content change both before and after restarting each node. Also completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured healthy baselines, rebooted node1 then node2 one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed on each, and verified services/data/crontab recovered on each before proceeding.
